description:
If an insurant could be possibly subrogated against, I get information about that. 
I check that case and if the possibility is really there, I send a request for payment to the insurant and make me a reminder. 
If recourse is not possible, I close the case. 
When we receive the money, I make a booking and close the case. 
If the insurant disagrees with the recourse, I'll have to check the reasoning of that. 
If he is right, I simply close the case. 
If he is wrong, I forward the case to a collection agency. It the deadline for disagreement is reached and we haven't received any money, I forward the case to the collection agency as well.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/recourse">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentRequest" name="Payment request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Payment" name="Payment"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Disagreement" name="Disagreement"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CaseReferral" name="Case referral"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Recourse">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CaseHandler" name="Case handler" processRef="Process_Recourse"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Insurant" name="Insurant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CollectionAgency" name="Collection agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentRequest" name="Payment request" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest" targetRef="Participant_Insurant" messageRef="Message_PaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Payment" name="Payment" sourceRef="Participant_Insurant" targetRef="Event_PaymentReceived" messageRef="Message_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Disagreement" name="Disagreement" sourceRef="Participant_Insurant" targetRef="Event_DisagreementReceived" messageRef="Message_Disagreement"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CaseReferral" name="Case referral" sourceRef="Task_ForwardCase" targetRef="Participant_CollectionAgency" messageRef="Message_CaseReferral"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Recourse" name="Handle possible recourse" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_InformationReceived" name="Information about possible recourse received"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckCase" name="Check case"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RecoursePossible" name="Is recourse possible?" default="Flow_RecourseNo"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPaymentRequest" name="Send request for payment" messageRef="Message_PaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeReminder" name="Make reminder"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" name="Wait for outcome" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PaymentReceived" name="Money received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PaymentReceived" messageRef="Message_Payment"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeBooking" name="Make booking"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseAfterPayment" name="Close case"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PaidCaseClosed" name="Case closed after payment"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DisagreementReceived" name="Disagreement received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DisagreementReceived" messageRef="Message_Disagreement"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckReasoning" name="Check reasoning"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReasoningCorrect" name="Is the reasoning correct?" default="Flow_ReasoningWrong"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseAfterCorrectReasoning" name="Close case"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CorrectReasoningCaseClosed" name="Case closed after correct reasoning"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DeadlineReached" name="Deadline for disagreement reached">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_Deadline"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ForwardCaseMerge" name="Forward case"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ForwardCase" name="Forward case to collection agency" messageRef="Message_CaseReferral"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CaseForwarded" name="Case forwarded to collection agency"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseWhenRecourseNotPossible" name="Close case"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RecourseNotPossible" name="Case closed: recourse not possible"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToCheck" sourceRef="Start_InformationReceived" targetRef="Task_CheckCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckToDecision" sourceRef="Task_CheckCase" targetRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecourseYes" sourceRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible" targetRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${recoursePossible}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecourseNo" sourceRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible" targetRef="Task_CloseWhenRecourseNotPossible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CloseNotPossibleToEnd" sourceRef="Task_CloseWhenRecourseNotPossible" targetRef="End_RecourseNotPossible"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestToReminder" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest" targetRef="Task_MakeReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReminderToWait" sourceRef="Task_MakeReminder" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitForPayment" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" targetRef="Event_PaymentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentToBooking" sourceRef="Event_PaymentReceived" targetRef="Task_MakeBooking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BookingToClose" sourceRef="Task_MakeBooking" targetRef="Task_CloseAfterPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ClosePaidToEnd" sourceRef="Task_CloseAfterPayment" targetRef="End_PaidCaseClosed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitForDisagreement" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" targetRef="Event_DisagreementReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DisagreementToReasoning" sourceRef="Event_DisagreementReceived" targetRef="Task_CheckReasoning"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReasoningToDecision" sourceRef="Task_CheckReasoning" targetRef="Gateway_ReasoningCorrect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReasoningCorrect" sourceRef="Gateway_ReasoningCorrect" targetRef="Task_CloseAfterCorrectReasoning">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${reasoningCorrect}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CloseCorrectReasoningToEnd" sourceRef="Task_CloseAfterCorrectReasoning" targetRef="End_CorrectReasoningCaseClosed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReasoningWrong" sourceRef="Gateway_ReasoningCorrect" targetRef="Gateway_ForwardCaseMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitForDeadline" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" targetRef="Event_DeadlineReached"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeadlineToForwardMerge" sourceRef="Event_DeadlineReached" targetRef="Gateway_ForwardCaseMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ForwardMergeToTask" sourceRef="Gateway_ForwardCaseMerge" targetRef="Task_ForwardCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ForwardToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ForwardCase" targetRef="End_CaseForwarded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
